title: BEE
bigQuestion: How does a bee help flowers?
paragraphs: A bee visits flowers to collect sweet nectar and pollen. Pollen sticks to the bee while it drinks nectar. When the bee visits another bright flower, some pollen rubs off. This transfer helps the flower make seeds and new fruit.
